blocks.text: This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements for Zscaler SDK for Mobile Apps.
The Global Insights dashboard enhancements include:

blocks.item: A comparison table between Wi-Fi and cellular access on devices
An ISP Leaderboard that displays the most impacted internet service providers (ISPs)

blocks.text: The interactive Threat Detector map is no longer available, which improves the dashboard's usability and its focus on actionable insights.
See image.
To learn more, see Viewing the Global Insights Dashboard.
Leverage Browser Access to enforce strict user authentication by using your identity provider, which issues a JSON Web Token that limits web application access.
See image.
Contact Zscaler Support to enable this feature.
To learn more, see About Browser Access.

Access the Global Insights dashboard to locate and monitor where your users' devices are distributed, view an overview of their digital experience performance, and see global threats that Zscaler detects and prevents.
See image.
To learn more, see Viewing the Global Insights Dashboard.

Enable more granular security controls by creating a device profile to maintain and enforce access to your application segments. After you create a device profile, you can then create an access policy that uses various criteria (e.g., hardware identifier, OS version) to evaluate each device that accesses your application segments.
See image.
To learn more, see About Device Profile and About Access Policy.
The Client Monitoring dashboard provides a high-level overview of users and their mobile devices by capturing important device details on usage, locations, operating systems, and hardware.
See image.
To learn more, see Viewing the Client Monitoring Dashboard.
Additional data path tunnel capabilities are added to increase support for tunnel evaluation.
To learn more, see Developer Reference.

blocks.heading: ZSDK Private Service Edges and Disaster Recovery

blocks.text: ZSDK Private Service Edges provide safe and secure access to your private applications. Disaster recovery allows your users to access applications in the event of a disruption that impacts Zscaler. When configuring a ZSDK Private Service Edge, you can enable Disaster Recovery for a ZSDK Private Service Edge group.
See image.
To learn more, see About ZSDK Private Service Edges and Viewing Disaster Recovery.
